{{Quote|He was creative, he was personal, even vindictive. How could a droid replicate that behavior?|Commander [[Stron]], to an Imperial operative|<ref name="TOR:ZP" />}}
'''Zero''' was a renegade espionage [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he reprogrammed several other droids to serve and defend himself and set up a [[Zero's lair|lair]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] near the [[Network Security District|Central Hub Prime]], though which passed all Imperial communications. Zero remotely hacked the hub and gained access to the top secret military data. Though his intrusion was noted and his identity traced, Imperials remained unaware that the hacker was in fact a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] ordered Zero neutralized, and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stron]] recruited for the task an Imperial hero who stormed Zero's lair and destroyed the droid.<ref name="TOR:ZP" />
